name: smwmusic-haunted-castle-last-belmont-standing-don-t-wait-until-the-night-remix
title: Haunted Castle - Last Belmont Standing ~ Don't Wait Until The Night (Remix)
description:
𝕯𝖗𝖆𝖈𝖚𝖑𝖆. 𝕯𝖎𝖊 𝖓𝖔𝖜, 𝖆𝖓𝖉 𝖑𝖊𝖆𝖛𝖊 𝖙𝖍𝖎𝖘 𝖜𝖔𝖗𝖑𝖉! 𝖄𝖔𝖚'𝖑𝖑 𝖓𝖊𝖛𝖊𝖗 𝖇𝖊𝖑𝖔𝖓𝖌 𝖍𝖊𝖗𝖊!

A remix of the last stage theme in the Haunted Castle arcade game, Don't Wait Until The Night (which is also heard in the battle against Julius Belmont in Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow.

This song works best in castles, factories, towers, final areas, & other levels with intense vibes.

Note:
There is a ADD ME TO ADDMUSICK.txt file that has the sample bank that you need to move to Addmusic_sample_groups.txt. Thunder and Yoshi sound effects are disabled.
There are two customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song file:
- e minor (the default pitch specifically for this remix)
- d minor (The original pitch from the games)
